paper_title: First indirect detection constraints on axions in the Solar basin
notes: Indirect detection of keV axions in the Solar basin via X-ray decay observed by NuSTAR. This is a solar/astrophysical source (not a DM haloscope), so no local DM density applies. Fig. 2 shows the axion-photon coupling limit (g_aee=0) using Poisson, Yellin, and CLs methods; CLs is most stringent. Data points estimated from Fig. 2 (no numerical table provided); masses 5-30 keV converted to eV. Paper also constrains axion-electron coupling (Fig. 1, 3) via g_aee=me/f slice, but primary photon-only exclusion is AxionPhoton. Values are rough plot reads; strongest limit ~2e-12 GeV^-1, over an order of magnitude below HB star cooling (6.6e-11 GeV^-1). | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.55, 6))
